built_from: kit/task-report/v2/Dockerfile, built for linux/amd64 and pushed to the deployment's registry
note: Pinned by qualify.ts pin --tag from the amd64 image's ID, which equals the manifest digest the deployment's registry serves; the reference stays a neutral name, and hosted runners resolve rbw-task-report@<digest> in the deployment's registry. A new pin changes the environment hash and with it the case ID.
